summary: Dry Sunday with light wind across the route, cool on the Las Pedrizas pass (about 4–13 °C); no AEMET warnings found. The Villanueva del Rosario page was stale and discarded, so the pass is judged from AEMET Antequera, adjusted for height.
sunset: Slightly cloudy over Málaga around sunset (18:04).

verdict.text: Dry and fairly bright: Málaga 9–20 °C and calm, Antequera area 5–15 °C with cloudy intervals (15% rain chance), Lucena 7–16 °C; no warnings found. No action needed.
